purpose: Provide a deterministic temporal, identity and state-transition substrate for connecting heterogeneous public data without silently mixing occurrence time, public-observation time, revisions or entity identities.

spine_layers.name: Temporal Spine
spine_layers.role: Normalize event time, public-observation time, release/publication time, retrieval time and revision time while preserving source semantics.

spine_layers.name: Identity Spine
spine_layers.role: Normalize source-specific entity identifiers to frozen canonical issuer/security/organization identities with validity intervals and provenance.

spine_layers.name: State Spine
spine_layers.role: Represent observable states and deterministic state transitions with as-of boundaries, revision lineage and source evidence.

spine_layers.name: Relation Spine
spine_layers.role: Connect T/I/S nodes to candidate contracts, receipts, negative evidence and discovery motifs without creating transitive authority.

invariants: public_observed_at is the admissible information boundary unless a candidate-specific contract explicitly proves a tighter boundary
retrieved_at is metadata and never substituted for public_observed_at
event_time/action_time is metadata unless public observability is independently proven
revision_time may only mutate post-boundary state and may not rewrite the historical prefix
same-day ambiguity fails closed when source dissemination time is not proven
mapping is frozen for the candidate/trial prefix
identity validity interval must cover the event boundary
source-specific identifier changes require explicit lineage
parent/subsidiary/corporate-action ambiguity is excluded or explicitly classified
mapping provenance is independently reproducible before cross-candidate reuse
state_after cannot be observed before transition_observed_at
future revisions cannot alter a closed historical prefix
every transition points to a public-observation boundary
state labels are deterministic and predeclared
state transitions do not imply return direction
